decision.reason: [ev-089253854710] is a one-line changelog entry. It only says that thanos objstore, dskit and "other modules" were upgraded, and it points to PR 10366. It groups several dependency upgrades together, and it gives no versions, no changed configuration, API or behaviour, no exposure condition and no operator consequence. The PR content or the upgrade-guide text is needed to say what changed for operators, such as any object-storage config changes.
